```{r}
#resetting the environment 
rm(list = ls())
#loading required packages 
library(dplyr) #for dataframe editing
library(ggplot2) #for making graphs
library(patchwork) #for combing two graphs

```



```{r}
#reading the files 
Hp <- read.csv("Humpback.csv.csv")
SST <- read.csv("SST_MB5370.csv.csv")

#getting the number of unique humpbacks appearing every year 

Hp_year <- Hp %>%
  filter(!is.na(NOM.NAME)) %>% # removing NAs
  group_by(ANNEE.YEAR) %>% #grouping by year 
  summarise(
    unique_whales = n_distinct(NOM.NAME), #only keeping distinct whales 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Hp_year

#joining the two datasets together 
Hp_SST <- Hp_year %>%
  left_join(SST, by = "ANNEE.YEAR")

#graphing whales per year alongside average temperature per year of gulf
HpPlot <- 
  ggplot(Hp_SST, aes(x = ANNEE.YEAR, y = unique_whales)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue") +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Unique Whales") + 
  theme_classic()
HpPlot

#graph for average SST over years (including on months from July-october)
SSTPlot <- 
  ggplot(Hp_SST, aes(x = ANNEE.YEAR, y = Mean_SST)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab("Mean SST (°C)") +
  theme_classic()
SSTPlot

#adding the two graphs onto the same plot 
final_plot <- HpPlot / SSTPlot
final_plot 
#saving the graph
ggsave("FinalPlot.jpg", plot=final_plot)
```
